scope: current working tree; configured CLI route registration; source declarations

coverage.schema: up() Schema::create/table declarations, including historical and conditional declarations; no migrations executed or live database queried

limitations: No authenticated browser or tenant request was executed.

Middleware inventory is route-level; framework global middleware requires source review.
